phaseSemantics.before: Base vector immediately before the named mutation; source Receipt is authoritative.
phaseSemantics.during: Named mutation and its required file or directory sync have completed, destination Receipt staging is synced, but destination generation is not published; source Receipt remains authoritative.
phaseSemantics.after: Destination Receipt generation and Receipt-directory fsync have completed; destination Receipt is authoritative.

vocabulary.pending: bound name does not yet exist and identity/hash/length remain pending
vocabulary.not-applicable: operation has no such bound name
vocabulary.present-before: bound object exists with exact request Before hash/UTF-8 length and linkCount 1
vocabulary.present-after: bound object exists with exact request After hash/UTF-8 length and linkCount 1
vocabulary.retained-before: same as present-before and never reclaimed by H03
vocabulary.retained-after: same as present-after and never reclaimed by H03
vocabulary.absent: name is absent; identity null, length 0, hash null
vocabulary.moved-absent: bound source name is absent because its inode was moved by RENAME_NOREPLACE
vocabulary.present-competing-replacement: retained adversary bytes with measured non-Before/non-After hash, length and identity
vocabulary.present-competing-inplace-bytes: retained inode bytes mutated through the pre-opened FD; stored on Target before capture and on Capture after capture
vocabulary.present-competing-rebind: retained new target binding with measured non-Before/non-After hash, length and identity
vocabulary.present-symlink-rejected: symlink is inventoried but never followed
vocabulary.present-hardlink-linkcount-gt-1: target or capture inode is inventoried and rejected because linkCount is not 1

algorithm: Select exactly one transition and its exact phase base vector.
Select exactly one adversary overlay, the same phase, and exactly one entry whose transitionId equals the selected transition.

If that entry is in results, resolve its oracleId to exactly one object in overlayOracles and deep-merge that resultVectorPatch over the base vector; arrays and scalar leaves replace, objects merge recursively.
If that entry is in notApplicable, emit not-applicable with its explicit reason and do not execute a helper.
For mount-device on a host that cannot inject safely, emit not-run and H03 No-Go.
No other transition, phase, adversary, class rule, oracle inference or fallback is permitted.
